name: Stoutlager Inn
summary: In Thelsamar, Stoutlager Inn gives travelers a warm hearth and a place to gather in western Loch Modan.

sections.title: A Welcoming Hearth in the Hills
sections.body: Stoutlager Inn anchors community life in western Loch Modan, within Thelsamar. Miners, mountaineers, and travelers between Dun Morogh and the Wetlands stop to trade rumors, find lodging, and share dwarven ale. Troggs and kobolds make the wilderness beyond Thelsamar more dangerous, while the inn’s stone walls and fires offer shelter.

faq.q: What services are available at the Stoutlager Inn?
faq.answer: Stoutlager Inn offers beds, provisions, and drinks for travelers crossing Loch Modan. Its innkeeper can bind hearthstones, and local merchants sell supplies.

faq.q: Where is the Stoutlager Inn located?
faq.answer: Stoutlager Inn stands in the center of Thelsamar, the main Alliance town in western Loch Modan, beside the main road.

faq.q: Why is the inn so important to Thelsamar?
faq.answer: Stoutlager Inn gives Thelsamar a place for food, lodging, and news. Local mountaineers post bounties there, and travelers plan excursions into the surrounding hills.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you may find the warmth of home at Stoutlager Inn, known for its hospitality, fresh ale, and reliable company far from Ironforge.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find shelter and prepare at Stoutlager Inn before heading north toward the Wetlands or patrolling the troubled valleys around the loch.
